cohort: The study participants were pregnant women from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood 2010 (COPSAC2010) cohort in Denmark and the Vitamin D Antenatal Asthma Reduction Trial (VDAART) cohort in the United States.
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI is associated with several pregnancy complications, and a BMI-associated metabolite score is even more strongly associated with these complications, with specific metabolites mediating the effect of BMI on gestational diabetes, suggesting metabolomic profiling could improve prediction and management of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI is associated with caesarean section and birth induction.
